findings.title: Working tree does not import: articulador_core relocation incomplete and uncommitted
findings.description: 11 core modules moved to articulador_ui/articulador_core/ and deleted from articulador_core/; 143 imports still reference the old path. App, pytest, mypy all fail.
evidence: git status: D articulador_core/*.py (11 files), ?? articulador_ui/articulador_core/
python articulador.py --health -> ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'articulador_core' (articulador.py:10)
findings.impact: Product cannot run or be tested; refactor invisible in git history.
findings.recommendation: Choose canonical location, update imports/pyproject/CI/gate/mypy/bandit/docs/tests, commit atomically with git mv.

findings.title: ArticuladorApp is a God Object: 114 methods, 2110 lines
findings.description: Single class owns window, theming, editing, document lifecycle, context articles, LLM request lifecycle, review dialogs, UI persistence, recents, clipboard.
findings.impact: High regression risk, poor testability, root cause of A-2/M-1/M-2.
findings.recommendation: Extract ThemeController, ChatController, ContextArticlesController following existing manager pattern.

findings.title: No re-entrancy guard in request(); cancel and finish can lose responses
findings.description: request() sets request_active unconditionally; only callers guard. _cancel_active_request clears ALL request_types/chunks.
evidence: app.py:1256-1266 request() sets request_active=True without checking
app.py:1445 finish drops response when request_id not in request_types
findings.impact: Double submit and silent loss of a valid response.
findings.recommendation: Introduce a single RequestState object; guard in request(); cancel only the current request; finish validates identity.

findings.title: Credential save is not transactional; config can change while UI shows error
findings.description: save_profiles and app state mutated before _persistir_credencial; keyring failure reports error though config was applied.
evidence: dialogs.py:439-462 save_profiles -> app.profiles = working -> _persistir_credencial -> except shows error
findings.recommendation: Apply credentials first returning (ok, err); save_profiles second; roll back on failure.

findings.title: Keyring reads on the Tk main thread freeze the UI
findings.description: key property calls storage.load_key() (keyring.get_password) on every evaluation, three times per send.
findings.impact: Intermittent UI freeze with locked Secret Service.
findings.recommendation: Resolve key once, cache in _resolved_key, make key an attribute.

findings.title: CI never verifies the package installs and runs from a clean environment
findings.description: Editable install plus conftest sys.path injection mask packaging and import-resolution failures.
findings.impact: Green pipeline does not guarantee a releasable package.
findings.recommendation: Add package job: python -m build, install wheel in clean venv outside repo, run articulador --health, pip check.

findings.title: Dead code and comments describing nonexistent RequestState
evidence: app.py:258 COLORS only written, tests/test_ui_integration.py:22 injects it
models.py:74 and llm_session_manager.py:18 reference RequestState (does not exist)
findings.recommendation: Delete dead code, fix comments and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

findings.title: Global bind_all Escape cancels requests from modal dialogs
findings.impact: Silent loss of in-flight work on a reasonable keypress.
findings.recommendation: Scope Escape to the main toplevel or ignore when focus is in another toplevel.

findings.title: threat_feed prototype has no caller and follows redirects contrary to its comment
evidence: no references to build_threat_context outside tests
findings.impact: Unmaintained network code with inaccurate security comment.
findings.recommendation: Move to experiments/ or integrate with no-redirect opener and time budget; fix comment.

findings.title: State and config directories/files do not set restrictive permissions
evidence: storage.py:114-124 chmod only inherits existing mode
findings.impact: estado.json (full conversation history) may be world-readable in multiuser systems.
findings.recommendation: mkdir(mode=0o700), explicit mode=0o600 for config.toml, estado.json, autosave.

findings.title: load_key swallows every keyring failure as 'no key'
findings.impact: Broken keyring is reported as missing configuration.
findings.recommendation: Catch only no-entry errors; surface backend failures in status bar.

findings.title: Autosave has no size cap; parse_findings parses before limiting
findings.recommendation: stat() check against MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES; cap len(clean) before raw_decode.

findings.title: No High-DPI awareness or tk scaling; hardcoded font family without fallback
findings.impact: Blurry UI and wrong font size on HiDPI; low-vision users affected.
findings.recommendation: SetProcessDpiAwareness(1) on Windows, scale from tk scaling, font fallback list.

findings.title: Dialogs use absolute pixel sizes exceeding small screens
requirements-test.txt duplicates and conflicts with dev extra and lock
evidence: locust not in any extra or CI
findings.recommendation: Remove requirements-test.txt; regenerate lock with perf extra if locust is kept.

findings.title: Visible error dialog gives no path to the log
findings.recommendation: Add 'Ver detalles' or show log path in status bar.
